headline: Sensex flat, Nifty gains as smallcaps jump amid global rate hike concerns
why: Post-Fed market reallocation triggered $496 million in Indian market outflows
Rising US Treasury yields pressured global investor sentiment and rate outlooks
IT sector performance dragged down the broader Sensex index performance
Analysts anticipate two RBI rate hikes by the end of CY 2026
whatHappening: NSE's ₹22,569-crore IPO reached full subscription on its second day
Maruti Suzuki launched automatic S-CNG variants for Swift, Dzire, and Baleno
Air India CEO considers merging AI Express to streamline group costs
Smallcap and metal stocks outperformed the broader market indices significantly

stocksInNews.sources: Launched automatic S-CNG variants for multiple models
IT drags ahead of Fed call
Weighing outlook for potential RBI rate hikes
FMCG sector showing strength in trade
Metals rise 1.5 percent in daily trade
Sensex slips into red after volatile session

summary: Indian markets ended mixed as Nifty gained while Sensex faced pressure from IT sector weakness and significant foreign outflows. The NSE IPO saw robust demand with full subscription on day two, while Maruti Suzuki expanded its green mobility offerings. Investors remain cautious due to rising US yields and analysts predicting two domestic rate hikes by 2026.
